import random, sys, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
tmpl=(b'\xaa'*8).hex(); kinds='KKKDZQTK'   # per=(8-4-1)*N=3N
def hdr(path):
    h=bytearray(b'\xaa'*8); h[3]=0x77; h[4]=0; h[5]=3; h[6]=len(path)+1; h[7]=0xaa
    return h.hex()
def build(caps, paths, counts, pinned=(), warm=0):
    nodes=sorted(set(n for p in paths for n in p))
    flows=[];offers={}
    for i,p in enumerate(paths):
        fid='f%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=p,template=tmpl,kinds=kinds))
        offers[fid]=[dict(header=hdr(p),count=counts[i])]
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=dict((n,caps[n]) for n in nodes),flows=flows,warmup=warm,
                pinned=list(pinned),offers=offers)

def timeit(req):
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); el=time.time()-st
    return got, el

# case A: 2 nodes, all flows use both, cap 11, distinct counts (=> distinct values)
paths=[['a','b']]*22
counts=list(range(1,23))
got,el=timeit(build({'a':11,'b':11},paths,counts))
print('A', 'time %.2f'%el, got['saved'], len(got['selected']))

# case B: same but equal counts (ties)
got,el=timeit(build({'a':11,'b':11},paths,[7]*22))
print('B', 'time %.2f'%el, got['saved'], len(got['selected']))

# case C: three node-sets, mixed values
paths=[['a','b'],['b','c'],['a','c']]*8
counts=[random.Random(i).randint(1,9) for i in range(24)]
got,el=timeit(build({'a':8,'b':8,'c':8},paths[:22],counts[:22]))
print('C', 'time %.2f'%el, got['saved'], len(got['selected']))

# case D: 6 nodes cap 3, paths of 3 nodes random (packing)
rng=random.Random(1)
nodes=['v%d'%i for i in range(6)]
paths=[rng.sample(nodes,3) for _ in range(22)]
counts=[rng.randint(1,5) for _ in range(22)]
got,el=timeit(build(dict((n,3) for n in nodes),paths,counts))
print('D', 'time %.2f'%el, got['saved'], len(got['selected']))

# case E: 22 nodes cap 1, paths 2 nodes = max matching with random weights
rng=random.Random(2)
nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(11)]
paths=[list(rng.sample(nodes,2)) for _ in range(22)]
counts=[rng.randint(1,3) for _ in range(22)]
got,el=timeit(build(dict((n,1) for n in nodes),paths,counts))
print('E', 'time %.2f'%el, got['saved'], len(got['selected']))

# case F: exhaustive-check for small variants of A/B/C/D to verify exactness incl. count objective
def brute_check(req):
    R=m.parse_request(req); F=R['flows']; caps=R['caps']
    ids=sorted(F); ben={fid:m.flow_benefit(F[fid],R['runs'][fid],R['warmup']) for fid in F}
    pinned=set(R['pinned'])
    best=None
    for r in range(len(ids)+1):
        for c in itertools.combinations(ids,r):
            S=set(c)
            if not pinned<=S: continue
            u={}
            ok=True
            for fid in c:
                for n in F[fid]['path']:
                    u[n]=u.get(n,0)+1
                    if u[n]>caps[n]: ok=False;break
                if not ok: break
            if not ok: continue
            v=sum(ben[fid] for fid in c)
            key=(v,-len(c))
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,c,v)
    return {'selected':sorted(best[1]),'saved':best[2]} if best else {'selected':[],'saved':0}
for name,(caps,paths,counts) in {
  'A':({'a':5,'b':5},[['a','b']]*8,[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]),
  'B':({'a':3,'b':3},[['a','b']]*8,[7]*8),
  'C':({'a':4,'b':4,'c':4},[['a','b'],['b','c'],['a','c']]*3,[3,1,2]*3),
  'D':(dict((n,2) for n in ['v0','v1','v2','v3']),[rng.sample(['v0','v1','v2','v3'],3) for _ in range(9)],[1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9]),
}.items():
    req=build(caps,paths,counts)
    got,el=timeit(req); ref=brute_check(req)
    print('check',name, 'OK' if (got['saved'],len(got['selected']))==(ref['saved'],len(ref['selected'])) else ('MISMATCH',got,ref), '%.2fs'%el)
